title: Mix up the way they speak

questions.prompt: A scene has 9 of 10 lines ending with "said." What would help most?

options.label: Add one action beat — a glance, a shrug, a small gesture.
Delete every line and start over.

questions.mentorPostScript: One action beat makes "said" feel intentional instead of automatic.

questions.prompt: Every single line is an action beat ("Iris frowned." "Cal shrugged."). What's the risk?

options.label: The reader loses track of who is speaking.
The reader becomes a marathon runner.

questions.mentorPostScript: Action beats are powerful but they don't say who's talking. Mix in a plain "X said" once in a while.

questions.prompt: A bare quote with no tag (“Why?”) works best when:

options.label: The reader can already tell who is speaking.
There are six characters in the scene.
The line is exactly 100 words long.

questions.mentorPostScript: No tag is fine when the rhythm makes the speaker obvious.
